name: Ionion Seafront Villas
pinSource: Developer website project page (karmadevelopers.com/projects/ionion-villas) embeds a Google Maps place pin with plus code 'XWF3+3C Sotira, Cyprus' = 8G6MXWF3+3C, decoded to 34.97269, 33.90356 (centre of a ~14 m cell). Consistent with the developer's Google Map screenshot (complex at the western end of the Ayia Thekla coast) and roughly with stated distances (~3.9 km straight line to Ayia Napa Marina vs stated 3 km). It marks the whole Ionion complex, not specifically villa H07 (complex is ~300 m long). Medium-high confidence.
amenities: Private overflow pool (1-1.80 m deep, glass mosaic, LED lights)
Sold fully furnished (furniture, appliances, linen, outdoor furniture)
Ducted/VRV air conditioning on ground floor, split units in bedrooms
Fireplaces in living room and master bedroom
Barbecue with pergola seating area (scheme feature list)
facts: Ionion is a completed scheme of 63 detached villas built in three phases on the seafront of Ayia Thekla, west of Ayia Napa.
Across the scheme, villas have 3, 4 or 5 bedrooms, 122-265 m² buildable area, plots of 338-861 m² and private overflow pools of 32-100 m² (leaflet).

Villa H07: 5 bedrooms on three levels - two bedrooms and a bathroom in the basement, kitchen/dining/sitting room and WC on the ground floor, three bedrooms upstairs with a sea-facing balcony; internal 165.72 m², total buildable 223.78 m², plot 773 m² (seafront).

H07 is sold fully furnished: a household-items list covers living and dining furniture, four furnished bedrooms, bedding and linen, kitchenware, 43-inch TV, oven, hob, extractor, fridge-freezer, washing machine, dishwasher, microwave, 4 split A/C units and outdoor dining set with 6 sunbeds.
Structure: concrete C25/30-C30/37 with B500C reinforcement, 25 cm clay masonry external walls with 5 cm external insulation, 8 cm roof insulation.

Finishes: Lastra 60x120 porcelain tiles (almond white; grey in bathrooms), Italian LUBE kitchen with Laminam-type worktop, Franke sinks, double-glazed aluminium frames, glass balustrades, white marble sills.

Heating/cooling: ducted A/C on ground floor (VRV), split units in bedrooms, built fireplaces in living room and master bedroom, provision for hydraulic underfloor heating; solar water heater (800 L tank, 150 L cylinder).
Pool: overflow type, depth 1-1.80 m, tricolour blue glass mosaic, marble coping, two LED lights, underground plant room, outdoor shower.

Developer-stated distances: sea 50 m (presentation) / 'frontline & 100 m' (docx), Sirens Beach 1.6-1.7 km, Ayia Thekla Beach 2.7-2.8 km, Ayia Napa Marina 3 km, Makronissos Beach 4.5 km, restaurants 500 m, supermarkets 2.2 km, Larnaca Airport 40 km.

conflicts: Bathrooms: price list 5 baths; website '5 Bath + WC'; presentation key facts '4 bathrooms + wc'. Price list wins (5); plan count is not conclusive.
Pool: docx says 'Private Infinity Pool' and 'Private 7 m x 10 m swimming pool'; price list, website, leaflet and spec say overflow. Used 'overflow'.
Distance to sea: presentation 50 m; docx/website 'Frontline & 100 m'; website calls H07 a '773 Seafront Plot'. Text says 'seafront plot' without a figure.
Docx feature list (outdoor solid-wood sauna, BBQ with pergola) is generic for the scheme; not in the H07 specification - not used in our text.
Household list furnishes 'basement bedroom' (one) + bedrooms 1-3 = 4 furnished bedrooms, while plans and price list show 5 bedrooms.
Name: website heading 'Ionion Luxury Villas', leaflet/logo 'Ionion seafront villas'; used 'Ionion Seafront Villas'.
